# VeChain v0.0.1 - Table of Contents

VeChainThor blockchain client for Elixir

## Pages

- [Introduction](https://vechain.hexdocs.pm/readme.md)
- [Changelog](https://vechain.hexdocs.pm/changelog.md)

## Modules

- [VeChain](https://vechain.hexdocs.pm/VeChain.md): Highest-level convenience API for basic VeChain blockchain interactions.
- [VeChain.Block](https://vechain.hexdocs.pm/VeChain.Block.md): Represents a VeChain block with its associated fields.

- [VeChain.Client.Thor](https://vechain.hexdocs.pm/VeChain.Client.Thor.md): Thor RESTful API client for VeChainThor blockchain.
- [VeChain.Configuration](https://vechain.hexdocs.pm/VeChain.Configuration.md): This module provides functions to manage and validate configuration settings across the VeChain SDK.

- [VeChain.Contract](https://vechain.hexdocs.pm/VeChain.Contract.md): Provides a base module for VeChain smart contract interactions.
This module uses `Ethers.Contract` under the hood and can set up
any necessary configuration for VeChain contracts if it is needed
in the future.

- [VeChain.Utils](https://vechain.hexdocs.pm/VeChain.Utils.md): Utility functions specific to VeChain. All other generic utilities are delegated from `Ethers.Utils`.
